comparison.objective: Sweep eight loose chips from a plate into a scrap trough without disturbing a loose workpiece.
comparison.physical_skill: Manipulating a loose bar for selective planar pushing around an obstacle.
comparison.success_condition: All eight chips enter the trough while the workpiece remains undisturbed; detailed displacement limits are omitted.
comparison.reason: It includes small loose-object containment, but tests sweeping many chips rather than creating fragments by precise impact and extracting them from recessed inserts.
